Make a meaningful difference with UnitingCare Queensland 

AtUnitingCarewe are leaders in crisis response, the protection of vulnerable people and children, financialresilienceand family wellbeing. OurFaDS(Family and Disability Services) teamworkpassionately across Queensland to make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

As aSupported Living Facilitator,you'llbe encouraged to grow,developand feel empowered to make the everyday easier for the people we care so passionately about. Let'smake a meaningful difference, together!

Your part in our UnitingCare team

You'llprovide care to your clients living in the community, supporting theirindependenceand improving their quality of life.

With no two days ever the same,you'llspend your time on the road completing your scheduled visits, interacting one-on-one with clients and their loved ones within their homes completing activities that include:

In home personal care, daily livingassistanceincluding showering, personal hygiene, meal preparation, house cleaning, laundry & ironing

Must be available to drive between clients with your own vehicle

Hours aremainly Mondayto Friday between the hours of 9am-5pm

Providing carein accordance withtheir individualised Care Plan

Supporting with community based recreational and social activities

Transportation andassistancewith shopping and appointments

What makes a difference for us? 

Able to work effectively with others in a team-oriented environment and provide excellent support to clients and co-workers

Able to effectively communicate in spoken and written English

Experience working in the Disability, Aged and Community sector is ideal but not essential -as long asyou have positive attitude and a willingness to learn

A current NDIS Worker screening check 

Current CPR and First Aid Certificate (requiredbefore you start) 

OpenDriversLicense and access to vehicle 

Car Insurance that is in your name

What makes a difference for you?

Flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance 

NFP Salary Packaging: Save tax and increase your take home pay by salary packaging your everyday living expenses and bills (up to $15,900) and meal entertainment (up to $2,650) per annum. To learn more about this benefit watch the video via the following link: Salary Packaging Explained 

A recognition and rewards platform, providing employee discounts at hundreds of retailers, including everyday expenses, holidays, health insurance, annual awards celebration, wellbeing and employee assistance programs 

12 weeks paid parental leave and 2 weeks paid partner leave, available after 6 months service, in addition to the government scheme 

Diversity and inclusive leave, offering paid gender affirmation leave and cultural leave options (paid and unpaid) for those who may celebrate Lunar New Year, Diwali, Ramadan, NAIDOC weeks and other significant cultural events 

Career development opportunities to challenge yourself, grow and make a meaningful difference 

A positive and inclusive team based on respect, shared standards, strong values and a commitment to serving others 

We'd love you to be part of our UnitingCare family 

Joining our FaDS, team, you'll also be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. The second-largest Queensland employer, we're a proud not-for-profit with more than 16,500 staff and 9,000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen's Hospital, and St Andrew's War Memorial Hospital, and have been leading by example for more than 100 years. 

Child safe, Child friendly

provide welcoming, safe and nurturing services for children 

implement measures to prevent child abuse and neglect within our services 

appropriately and immediately address child abuse and neglect if it does occur

Diversity & Inclusion 

Our approach is simple - everybody is welcome here. At UnitingCare, diversity is at the core of our who we are, our mission and our values. We are committed to providing equal opportunities to all employees no matter their sex, race, culture, sexual orientation, disability or gender identity. Demonstrating our commitment to reconciliation and building long-term employment opportunities for First Nations peoples, UnitingCare strongly encourages Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander applicants for this position. 

Safe workplace 

We work hard to make our services welcoming and safe for every person. We are united in keeping children, young people and the elderly safe from harm, within our services, workplaces and the communities we support. We are committed to speaking up loudly for their safety.

We are committed in creating services and workplaces that are welcoming and safe for every person. We work together to protect children, young people, adults and the elderly from harm within our services and the communities we support. We speak up for their safety to ensure their voices are heard.   About Joii: 
Joii undertakes various trade work for businesses throughout Queensland. By taking up a position with Joii it means that you are part of a bigger family and have access to a range of opportunities with a number of businesses. You also get the added bonus that what you do will make a difference in the community.

Our clients are some of Australia’s biggest and strong demand will ensure long-term employment.
We believe in Creating Opportunity and any profits we create do exactly that for those who need a little bit of extra support.

Joii provides hope and opportunity for disadvantaged and vulnerable people. Joii's approach is twofold:
•	We provide social impact programs that offer hope and opportunity for the disadvantaged and vulnerable. The programs focus on providing employment, pathways to employment, and housing opportunities.
•	We operate sustainable funding creating social enterprises whose objective is to support the vision.

The Opportunity:
Joii offers secure, well-paid positions with the added bonus that what you do will make a difference in our community. 

Due to a long, strong, and ongoing pipeline of work we are ungently seeking enthusiastic and motivated applicants for the positions of qualified Motor Mechanic within our Queensland Trades Team who will work for our valued clients.  You will be working from either Joii Limited Brisbane office or Joii Limited regional office Deebing Heights QLD.

Essential skills needed:
•	Qualification as a Diesel Mechanic
•	Expertise knowledge of current heavy vehicle maintenance requirements.
•	Be able to read and interpret technical manuals.
•	Hold all industry required tickets and tools.
•	Supply & maintain own commercial grade tools, noting a tool maintenance allowance is included in the salary package) 
•	Provide own vehicle to get themselves and their tools to site. 
•	Maintain current driver’s license.

About You:
•	Able to work unsupervised and part of a team.
•	Able to follow instructions.
•	Hard working and reliable.
•	Attention to detail and able to work to deadlines.

What you need to do now
If you are interested and have the experience, we would love to hear from you!
Please click the 'APPLY' button now and send through your resume and cover letter detailing your previous relevant experience and why you are the perfect candidate for our team.

Please note, due to the high number of applications we expect to receive, we will only be responding to applicants who have been successful in securing an interview.

Additional Information:
AQF Certificate III including at least two years of on-the-job training, or AQF Certificate IV (ANZSCO Skill Level 3)
The role includes repairing, maintaining and testing heavy vehicles and other diesel engines and related mechanical components of buses, trucks and heavy vehicles.

Tasks Include:
•	 detecting and diagnosing faults in engines and parts
•	dismantling and removing engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms and other components, and checking parts
•	diagnosing and testing with the assistance of computers
•	repairing and replacing worn and defective parts and reassembling mechanical components, and referring to service manuals as needed 
•	order parts and maintain Inventories.
•	performing scheduled maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups, to achieve smoother running of vehicles and ensure compliance with regulations.
•	rebuilding engines and parts after being repaired.
•	welding and painting of vehicles and components 
•	may inspect vehicles and issue roadworthiness certificates or detail work required to achieve roadworthiness.


Employer questions
•	Your application will include the following questions:
•	Have you completed a qualification as a Diesel Mechanic?
•	Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
•	How many years' experience do you have as a Diesel Mechanic?

Job description

Australia Network Services Pty Ltd (ANS) is seeking a suitably qualified and experienced Software Engineer for our client operating in the software development, IT services, and digital solutions industry in Sydney, Australia.

On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, maintaining, and improving software applications and systems. You will work closely with internal teams, business stakeholders, and technical staff to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused software solutions.


Job Title: Software Engineer, Full-Time Position
ANZSCO Code: 261313 Software Engineer
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: 38 hours per week
Work Location: In person
Industry: Software Development / IT Services / Digital Solutions


Key Responsibilities
The successful candidate will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, system design, frontend and backend development, database integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing system maintenance.

Main Duties and Tasks
- Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into software solutions.
- Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, platforms, and system features.
- Develop frontend interfaces using technologies such as JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and application logic using suitable programming languages and frameworks.
- Design, manage, and optimise databases using SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar database systems.
- Develop RESTful APIs and support integration between internal systems and third-party platforms.
- Write clean, efficient, reusable, and maintainable code in accordance with development standards.
- Conduct debugging, troubleshooting, code reviews, and performance optimisation.
- Participate in system design, software architecture planning, and technical documentation.
- Support cloud-based deployment, version control, CI/CD, and DevOps activities using tools such as AWS, Azure, Git, Jenkins, or similar.
- Work with product managers, designers, business users, and technical teams to deliver software that meets business objectives.
- Prepare user guides, technical documentation, release notes, and system support materials.
- Maintain data security, system reliability, and compliance with workplace policies and procedures.
- Support ongoing system upgrades, enhancements, and legacy system improvements.

Essential Requirements
- Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience as a Software Engineer, Software Developer, Full-Stack Developer, or in a similar software development role.
- Experience in frontend development using JavaScript, React, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, or similar technologies.
- Experience with backend development, APIs, databases, and system integration.
- Knowledge of programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, Java, or similar.
- Experience with SQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or other relational database systems.
- Understanding of software development lifecycle, system design, testing, debugging, and deployment processes.
- Experience using Git, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools, or DevOps practices is highly regarded.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills.
- Ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced technical environment.


If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position and assess your suitability for the role.

Due to their expanding international footprint of advisors and corporate offices spanning Melbourne, Queensland, and Dubai, their infrastructure requires enterprise-grade engineering and now seek an experienced Computer?Network and System Engineer to join the team in Hampton East, Victoria. 

?? 

The Role: 

This is a full time role with an annual salary set at $150,000 plus superannuation, and will be based in Hampton East, Victoria. 

? 

The Responsibilities: 

Design, deploy, and manage secure, high-availability Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless environments across all corporate offices, including Hampton East (VIC), Mermaid Beach (QLD), and Dubai. 

Implement advanced networking technologies and configure routers, firewalls, and network switches to prioritise high-bandwidth traffic, ensuring seamless VoIP communication.  

Create, update, and maintain detailed technical documentation, including network inventories, configuration change logs, maintenance procedures, and fault resolution records. 

Design and deploy network configurations, incorporating high-availability routing protocols, Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), Quality of Service (QoS) rules, and secure site-to-site VPN tunnels. 

Implement SoftwareDefined Networking (SDN) and develop programmatic, APIdriven workflows across network hardware using automation tools such as PowerShell, Bash, Python, and RESTful integrations to improve operational efficiency and system reliability. 

Monitor and analyse network traffic, capacity, and utilisation metrics, and evaluate endtoend network infrastructure performance across all corporate office locations. 

Evaluate and propose technical enhancements to network operations, interconnected server infrastructure, internal hardware, distributed PropTech applications, and hybrid operational environments. 

Optimise 4K media-rendering architectures and secure localised Network attached Storage (NAS) configurations, improving internal high-volume data-pipeline workflows for the marketing division. 

Oversee network and system configurations to ensure smooth data flows between real estate-specific APIs, external listing syndications (e.g., Realestate.com.au, Domain), and internal master CRMs. 

Provision, test, and deploy complex server networks, cloud systems (Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory / Entra ID), and endpoint systems using modern Mobile Device Management (MDM) software. 

Formulate comprehensive testing strategies to validate network throughput, failover systems, and server redundancy, ensuring the agency maintains its strict zero-downtime metric during business hours. 

Provide expert troubleshooting and fault-finding services to isolate, diagnose, and resolve intricate network bugs, hardware failures, system anomalies, or cross-platform software conflicts. 

Troubleshoot complex issues across hardware, networks, software, database applications, servers, and workstations, coordinating with internal teams and vendors, and maintaining high service standards. 

Actively contribute to ZED Real Estate’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) by supporting the implementation and upkeep of its policies, procedures and controls, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information in alignment with ISO/IEC?27001. 

Design and execute network security baselines, including Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Zero-Trust conditional access rules, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and advanced endpoint detection systems. 

Architect and manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) lifecycle workflows to enforce continuous security baselines across automated user onboarding and offboarding frameworks. 

Create, test, and preserve robust data backup structures, comprehensive disaster recovery workflows, and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) to secure sensitive real estate escrow accounts and high-net-worth data. 

 

The Requirements: 

A Bachelor’s degree or higher qualification in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related ICT Major. 

At least 5 years of relevant professional experience as a Network Engineer, Systems Engineer, or ICT Systems Administrator in a corporate setting 

Professional infrastructure certifications are highly regarded (e.g., Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator, CompTIA Security+). 

At least 5 years demonstrated experience of core networking models and protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, VPN, switching, routing). 

At least 5 years experience managing corporate directory platforms and infrastructure identities (Microsoft cloud technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra and Intune). 

Must have over 5 years’ experience to implement, administer, and troubleshoot network infrastructure devices, including wireless access points, firewall, routers, switches, controllers 

Must know how to setup virtual configurations in VMWare vSphere and Hyper-V 

At least 5 years of experience with server virtualisation, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and hybrid integration projects. 

Strong analytical skills and sound administration skills 

Quick to grasp new ideas and concepts 

Ability to work to tight deadlines and under immense pressure at times

REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS (RECRUITER) on behalf of CareSquad Pty Ltd T/A Care Squad 

Employer : Care Squad Pty Ltd 
Location: 214 Hampstead Rd, Clearview SA 5085 
Position: Full-time
Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus superannuation


ABOUT US

At Care Squad, we have a mission to improve the quality of life for people living with a disability, build confidence, dignity, and assistance to develop personal skills. As a small provider based in South Australia, we have a dedicated and caring team that focuses on the individual and their own personal wants, needs, and goals, rather than a faceless bureaucracy for whom you are simply a number. 

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Aged or Disabled Carer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will provide personal care support to elderly clients, individuals with disabilities and ensuring their well-being by assisting with daily activities to enhance their quality of life. You will be responsible for providing personal care, emotional support, and assistance with household tasks. Your work will make a significant difference in the lives of those you support.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Personal Care Assistance: Provide compassionate support with daily personal care tasks such as bathing, dressing, grooming, and toileting, ensuring clients’ dignity and comfort.

Support with Mobility: Assist clients with mobility needs, including transferring, repositioning, and using mobility aids to ensure safety and independence.

Medication Assistance: Aid with medication reminders and ensure clients adhere to prescribed medication schedule, while observing and reporting any health changes.

Daily Living Activities: Support clients with household tasks like meal preparation, cleaning, laundry, and shopping, promoting a safe and comfortable living environment and accompanying aged and disabled persons during daily activities.

Companionship & Emotional Support: Offer companionship and encourage social engagement, ensuring clients feel valued, supported, and emotionally connected.

Care Plan Implementation: Collaborate with care management teams to follow and update personalized care plans, ensuring each client’s needs are met with respect and individualized attention.

Documentation & Reporting: Accurately record care provided and report any changes in clients’ health, behavior, or environment to supervisors to ensure ongoing quality of care.

Promote Independence: Empower clients to maintain as much independence as possible in their daily activities, fostering self-confidence and autonomy.

Continuous Learning: Participate in training programs and stay updated on best practices in personal care and disability support to provide the highest standard of care.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL REQUIRE

•	AQF Certificate III in Individual support or higher relevant qualification is required.
•	12 months full-time or equivalent part-time or casual basis employment with proven experience is required in Aged / Disability Care Services. 
•	Valid Australian driver’s license is must, along with comprehensive car insurance. 
•	Applicants must be willing to accept shift allocations at client locations across metropolitan, regional, and outer regional South Australia, depending on operational requirements and client care needs. Flexibility to travel between client locations is an essential requirement of this position.
•	Strong interpersonal skills, a compassionate, patient approach.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of team.
•	A valid National Police Check, Working with Children Check and other NDIS entry level certificates are required.
•	First Aid, Manual Handling and CPR Certificate is required.

BENEFITS

•	Work in a supportive and inclusive team environment.
•	Opportunities for career development and training.
•	Flexible working arrangements to suit your lifestyle.
•	Meaningful work where you make a real impact.
•	Opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of others
